details: Both Archer and Piedmont perform RCSA for overlapping business lines. Three business lines still use Piedmont, creating dual maintenance burden.
IssuesPortal and Archer both track issues. The ERT parallel tracker further compounds the overlap. Weekly manual reconciliation bridges the gap.
Change Risk Tool and Change Log serve identical functions. Dual-entry requirement consumes 2.0 FTE with a 15-20% error rate.
KRI Hub dashboard overlaps with Risk Reporting Hub's KRI view. Both consume the same underlying data but present it through different interfaces.
Risk Reporting Hub depends on LossDB feed with 3-5 day lag. Manual triangulation bridges the gap daily.
